hook: Webb finds carbon dioxide ice mixed into water ice around the young star beta Pictoris.

readout.label: Crystallinity of water ice in disk

summary: Near-infrared spectra of the disk show amorphous water ice and CO2 ice, including the rare 13CO2 form, mixed at about 1 CO2 to 10 water. That mix suggests the ices formed in cold conditions, likely in interstellar space, and that frequent collisions spread icy grains through the disk. The conclusions rest on spectral modeling of one disk.
title: Carbon dioxide and amorphous water ices in the debris disk around β Pictoris.
